grh_3d5943482c442f3fdd5a.title: Words at War 43-08-07 (07) Prisoner of the Japs
paragraphs: American correspondent Gwen Dew is trapped in Hong Kong when Japan attacks in December 1941. She lives through the siege, surrender and months of internment marked by hunger, brutality and humiliation, while continuing to observe her captors as a reporter. After seven months, Dew is included in a civilian prisoner exchange and sails toward freedom, ending her account by reminding listeners that many Allied prisoners remain behind.

grh_3dbcc65ffa0d34f674d1.title: The Chest
paragraphs: Harold brings home a heavy brass-bound chest bought cheaply at auction, despite his family’s anger over the purchase. When they force it open, the inside is stained with old blood, and soon the chest seems to move and strike on its own: Harold’s son is found dead beneath its lid and his wife disappears upstairs after confronting it. Left alone, Harold attacks the advancing chest with an axe, while a later revelation identifies it as the very chest in which a murderer once concealed a young woman’s body.
